entity_raw.definition_raw:
You anticipate the attacks of more than one enemy at once.

Prerequisite(s): Dex 13, Dodge, Improved Unarmed Strike, Acrobatics 1 rank, Perception 1 rank.

Benefit(s): As a move action when using this style, you can select a number of creatures you are aware of equal to your Dexterity modifier. You can’t be flanked by the selected creatures until the start of your next turn.
